shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '\\n--- DOD ---\\n' && cat .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- TEST FILES ---\\n' && rg --files | rg '("'^|/)(.*'"\\.(test|spec)\\.)|test-commands.yml|reanchor.mjs' | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd; git status --short --branch; ls -la .lore; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; rg --files src | rg '(chatOrchestrator|\\.test\\.)'; rg -n \"beforeSession|onError|afterSession|specs/\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/config.test.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; sed -n '1,240p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs; rg -n \"specs/|spec anchor|@spec|spec:\" src scripts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; git diff --check; git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md; nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,18p'; git remote -v"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test: define beforeSession failure hooks" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch; git rev-parse HEAD; git rev-parse @{u}; git log -1 --oneline'
